Dr. Denis Anikiev and Dr. Umair bin Waheed, together with students from the SEEM Group, organized a hands-on workshop titled *Introduction to AI Coding Agents: From Idea to Reproducible Mini-Projects* for students enrolled in a machine-learning course.

Participants used Visual Studio Code and Codex to develop small, structured scientific-code projects. The guided exercises emphasized project organization, debugging, documentation, and reproducibility alongside critical review of AI-generated code and its limitations.

The session was the first step toward an expanded two-day training initiative for PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, and research staff. The public project page brings together the reusable workshop materials and supporting resources.
